description: Codex-native 0.7.1 workflow with exact mixed Sol routing, latency guardrails, active-child scope locks, and terminal coordination barriers.

interface.shortDescription: 0.7.1: exact mixed Sol routing with latency, ownership, and terminal-barrier guardrails.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor 0.7.1 routes every request by default. Sol primary keeps intent, architecture/contracts, authorization, risk, integration, and acceptance. Explorer uses Sol Low; deep explorer, worker, and normal reviewer use Sol Medium; critical-risk reviewer uses Sol High; tester alone retains native Luna Max. Sol routes never request fast or priority service. Known exact paths skip reconnaissance, worker and tester packets are batched, and review runs only for high risk or explicit requests after the final candidate. Ownership ledgers, one-writer safety, terminal barriers, same-child correction, browser/tester boundaries, and isolated external-specialist safety remain enforced.
defaultPrompt: Route through Sol Advisor 0.7.1 with exact mixed Sol routing and latency guardrails.
Use compatibility lanes only when I explicitly authorize them.
